comment: Security groups for Tier Model. Rarely changes after initial deployment unless organizational structure changes.

groups.name: PAW Domain Join
groups.description: Members of this group are delegated rights to join machines to the domain in the Tier Model PAW Staging OU
groups.comment: Group to allow Domain Join of PAWs to the PAW Staging OU

groups.name: Tier 0 Admins
groups.description: Members of this group administer Tier 0, 1, and 2 resources
groups.comment: Group to allow management of the Tier Model Administration OU without requiring Domain Admin rights

groups.name: Tier 0 Member Servers
groups.description: Members of this group required to participate in Tier 0 AuthSilo Policies and IPSec Require RDP and WinRM between Tier 0 PAW Devices to Domain Controllers and Tier 0 Member Servers.
groups.comment: Group used to establish AuthSilo and IPSec policies for Tier 0 Member Servers, Domain Controllers, and Tier 0 PAW Devices

groups.name: Tier 0 Operators
groups.description: Members of this group are delegated rights to log on to Tier 0 PAWs
groups.comment: Group provides non-elevated logon rights to Tier 0 PAWs

groups.name: Tier 0 PAW Devices
groups.description: Members of this group required to participate in Tier 0 AuthSilo Policies and IPSec Require RDP and WinRM between Tier 0 PAW Devices to Domain Controllers and Tier 0 Member Servers.
groups.comment: Group used to establish AuthSilo and IPSec policies for Tier 0 Member Servers, Domain Controllers, and Tier 0 PAW Devices

groups.name: Tier 0 Server Operators
groups.description: Members of this group are members of the local Administrators group on all Tier 0 Member Servers
groups.comment: Group used to allow Local Administrator rights on Tier 0 Member Servers, but not Domain Controllers

groups.name: Tier 0 Service Accounts
groups.description: Members of this group are service accounts within Tier 0 that should be denied outside Tier 0.
groups.comment: Group should contain all Tier 0 service accounts to facilitate GPO User Rights Assignment and IPSec rules

groups.name: Tier 0 Vpn Accounts
groups.description: Members of this group are only allowed VPN connectivity from a Tier 0 PAW device.
groups.comment: Group is only required if VPN access is allowed to Tier 0 VPN User Account from a Tier 0 PAW device

groups.name: Tier 1 Admins
groups.description: Members of this group can administer Tier 1 objects
groups.comment: Group to allow management of the Tier Model Administration > Tier 1 Child OU's

groups.name: Tier 1 Member Servers
groups.description: Members of this group required to participate in Tier 1 AuthSilo Policies IPSec Require RDP and WinRM between Tier 1 PAW Devices to Tier 1 Member Servers.
groups.comment: Group used to establish AuthSilo and IPSec policies for Tier 1 Member Servers, Domain Controllers, and Tier 1 PAW Devices

groups.name: Tier 1 Operators
groups.description: Members of this group can log on to Tier 1 PAWs
groups.comment: Group provides non-elevated logon rights to Tier 1 PAWs

groups.name: Tier 1 PAW Devices
groups.description: Members of this group required to participate in Tier 1 AuthSilo Policies IPSec Require RDP and WinRM between Tier 1 PAW Devices to Tier 1 Member Servers.
groups.comment: Group used to establish AuthSilo and IPSec policies for Tier 1 Member Servers and Tier 1 PAW Devices

groups.name: Tier 1 Server Domain Join
groups.description: Members of this group are delegated rights to join machines to the domain in the Tier Model Tier 1 Servers Staging OU.
groups.comment: Group to allow Domain Join of Tier 1 member servers to the Tier 1 Server Staging OU

groups.name: Tier 1 Server Operators
groups.description: Members of this group are administrators of Tier 1 Servers
groups.comment: Group to allow management of computer objects in the Tier 1 Member Server OU

groups.name: Tier 1 Service Accounts
groups.description: Members of this group are service accounts within Tier 1 that should be denied outside Tier 1.
groups.comment: Group should contain all Tier 1 service accounts to facilitate GPO User Rights Assignment and IPSec rules

groups.name: Tier 1 Vpn Accounts
groups.description: Members of this group are only allowed VPN connectivity from a Tier 1 PAW device.
groups.comment: Group is only required if VPN access is allowed to Tier 1 VPN User Account from a Tier 1 PAW device

groups.name: Tier 2 Account Operators
groups.description: Members of this group can create, modify and delete End-User user objects in the Tier 2 End-User Accounts OU.
groups.comment: Group has full control of user objects in the Tier 2 End-User Accounts OU, but not manage passwords for end-user accounts.

groups.name: Tier 2 Admins
groups.description: Members of this group can administer Tier 2 Objects
groups.comment: Group to allow management of the Tier Model Administration > Tier 2 Child OU's

groups.name: Tier 2 Computer Quarantine Operators
groups.description: Members of this group can log on to quarantine devices. This group must not be a member of Tier 2 Operators
groups.comment: Group allows logging into quarantined devices only under the Tier Model Computer Quarantine OU

groups.name: Tier 2 Device Operators
groups.description: Members of this group can create, modify and delete End-User computer objects in the Tier 2 End-User device OU.
groups.comment: Group has full control over computer objects in the Tier 2 End-User Devices OU.

groups.name: Tier 2 Group Operators
groups.description: Members of this group can create, modify and delete Tier 2 Groups in the Tier 2 End-User Groups OU.
groups.comment: Group has full control over group objects in the Tier 2 End-User Groups OU.

groups.name: Tier 2 Help-desk Operators
groups.description: Members of this group are Help Desk Operators for Tier 2 and can reset passwords and unlock accounts for End-User accounts in Tier 2.
groups.comment: Group has full control over user objects in the Tier 2 End-User Accounts OU, including password resets and account unlocks.

groups.name: Tier 2 Local Device Operators
groups.description: Members of this group can log on to Tier Model End-User devices to perform local administrative tasks. This group must not be a member of Tier 2 Operators.
groups.comment: Group provides local administrator rights on Tier 2 End-User Devices, but does not allow logon to Tier 2 PAWs or managing Active Directory objects in the Tier 2 OU's.

groups.name: Tier 2 Operators
groups.description: Members of this group can log on to Tier 2 PAWs
groups.comment: Group provides non-elevated logon rights to Tier 2 PAWs

groups.name: Tier 2 Service Accounts
groups.description: Members of this group are service accounts within Tier 2 that should be denied outside Tier 2.
groups.comment: Group has restricted access to Tier 2 resources only.

groups.name: Tier 2 Vpn Accounts
groups.description: Members of this group are only allowed VPN connectivity from a Tier 2 PAW device.
groups.comment: Group is only required if VPN access is allowed to Tier 1 VPN User Account from a Tier 1 PAW device
